text:
Gold Price in 2012
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2012, the LBMA gold price fell 5.0% between 2012-01-31 ($1,744) and 2012-12-28 ($1,658). The highest sampled price was $1,776 in September and the lowest was $1,558 in May. The mean of these observations was $1,678. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
